**Below‑attendance course:** CS301 – Database Management Systems (attendance 66.9 %) [SQL]. - The minimum required attendance is **75 %** per course [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance]. - CS301’s attendance (66.9 %) is **below 75 %** but **≥ 65 %**, so it falls in the **condonable range** [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3 Condonation of attendance]. **Condonation eligibility** | Course | Attendance | Condonation possible? | Conditions | |--------|------------|-----------------------|------------| | CS301 – Database Management Systems | 66.9 % [SQL] | Yes | • Submit a condonation application with supporting documents (e.g., medical certificate) to the Head of Department.
• Pay the condonation fee of **₹500** per course.
• Request must be made **before the last teaching day of the term**.
• You may receive condonation for up to **two courses** in this term. [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3 Condonation of attendance] | All other registered courses meet or exceed the 75 % threshold, so no further action is needed for them.
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM (SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = 'S2024CS006') AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S2024CS006' AND e.status = 'enrolled' ORDER BY c.course_code LIMIT 200
